A '''raid''' on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pendari]] was undertaken by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="gg11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref> Prior to the raid, the Rebels employed a [[Unidentified Pendari slicer|slicer]] to discover the refitting schedule of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Gallant Sun]]''.<ref name="cswe">{{CSWECite|I|316|''Gallant Sun''}}</ref> With this information, the Rebels were able to destroy the ''Gallant Sun'' with minimal loss of life.<ref name="gg11" />
